Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33(3) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015 (SEBI LODR), we enclose herewith the Audited Standalone and Consolidated financial results (���the Statement���) of the Company for the financial year ended 31st March 2022, approved at the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held earlier today. Further, we would like to inform that, the Directors have also recommended a Final Dividend of 110% i.e. Rs. 1.10 per Equity Share of Re. 1/- each, which shall be paid after the Annual General Meeting, subject to the approval of shareholders.

Trent Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on February 18, 2013, have approved to purchase from TVS Shriram Growth Fund I ("the Fund") its entire shareholding of 18,25,074 Equity Shares of Rs. 10/- each of Landmark Ltd., a subsidiary of the Company for a consideration of Rs. 84 crores. Further, it has been agreed between the parties that the Fund would retain an option to invest in a minority stake in Westland Limited (also a subsidiary of the Company) at a future date. The Company would continue to pursue the build out of the Landmark format, increasingly focusing on family entertainment categories and seek to integrate these operations with the Westside business. This is aimed at realizing cost and other operating synergies.

Trent Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on July 04, 2012 has approved, an issue of upto 16,67,000 Equity Shares to Tata Sons Limited, the Promoter of the Company and/or Other companies in the Promoter Group on a preferential basis, in accordance with the provisions of SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2009 ("SEBI ICDR Regulations"). The proposed issue will be made at a price to be determined as per the SEBI ICDR Regulations. The aforesaid proposed Preferential Issue is subject to the approval of the members of the Company at the forthcoming Annual General Meeting.

Trent Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 25, 2011, inter alia, have approved the following : (1) Recommended payment of dividend @ 0.1% per annum i.e. 1.02 paise per CCPS Series A of Rs. 10/- each on 44,51,414 CCPS Series A from the date of allotment, i.e. August 28, 2010 and up to the date on which the CCPS Series A are compulsorily and automatically converted into one fully paid up Equity share of Rs. 10 each i.e. September 01, 2011. The dividend on CCPS Series A will be paid within 30 days after the same has been approved by the shareholders at the forthcoming Annual General Meeting as per the Letter of Offer. A record date will be fixed at a later date in consultation with the Stock Exchanges to ascertain who would be eligible for the allotment of the fully paid up equity shares and the payment of dividend; (2) Also, recommended payment of Dividend @ 0.1% i.e. Re. 1 per Redeemable Preference Share of Rs. 1000/- each, on 70,000 Preference Shares, for approval by the shareholders.
